MentorAfterhoursDialog.title: The Mentor
MentorAfterhoursDialog.plainText: I've been watching, you're doing well.

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor
nextDialogue.plainText: Once you close the shop for the day...

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor
nextDialogue.plainText: You should have time to go outside before going to sleep.

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor
nextDialogue.plainText: You still remember the way to the Dumping Grounds right?

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor
nextDialogue.plainText: Going out at night takes time.

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor
nextDialogue.plainText: You won't open as early the next day, and you'll miss a customer.

MentorIntroDialog.title: The Mentor
MentorIntroDialog.plainText: Hey, just dropping by to see your first day.

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor
nextDialogue.plainText: Looks like you are all set.

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor
nextDialogue.plainText: Listen, I got this for you

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor
nextDialogue.plainText: *He pulls some notes from his jacket pocket and places them on the counter.*

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor
nextDialogue.plainText: Just some things I wouldn't want you to forget.

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor
nextDialogue.plainText: Remember to keep both sides of the counter clear, ok?

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor
nextDialogue.plainText: I've got some useful information for you.

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor
nextDialogue.plainText: Word is that a mining expedition is coming back tomorrow...

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor
nextDialogue.plainText: So the market will be flush with Materials.

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor
nextDialogue.plainText: Prices will fall, for a while, while supply outweighs demand.

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor
nextDialogue.plainText: Try to take advantage of this information.

nextDialogue.title: CLIENT
nextDialogue.plainText: Thank you for your cooperation.

nextDialogue.title: CLIENT
nextDialogue.plainText: I'll let you off with a warning.

nextDialogue.title: CLIENT
nextDialogue.plainText: Don't let me see that again.

nextDialogue.title: CLIENT
nextDialogue.plainText: They will be seized.

nextDialogue.title: CLIENT
nextDialogue.plainText: Have a secure shift.

SecurityDialogInspectionSeizureStolen.title: CLIENT
SecurityDialogInspectionSeizureStolen.plainText: Looks like there's some stolen items.

nextDialogue.title: CLIENT
nextDialogue.plainText: They will be seized.

nextDialogue.title: CLIENT
nextDialogue.plainText: Have a secure shift.

nextDialogue.title: CLIENT
nextDialogue.plainText: Step aside, I will be conducting an full inspection.

nextDialogue.title: CLIENT
nextDialogue.plainText: Step aside, I will be conducting an full inspection.

SecurityDialogInspectionLastLine.title: CLIENT
SecurityDialogInspectionLastLine.plainText: Open your cargo hold and step aside.

nextDialogue.title: CLIENT
nextDialogue.plainText: You are under arrest for possession of Contraband.

nextDialogue.title: CLIENT
nextDialogue.plainText: I would have you arrested for this.

nextDialogue.title: CLIENT
nextDialogue.plainText: But looks like you have friends in high places.

nextDialogue.title: CLIENT
nextDialogue.plainText: Next time you won't be so lucky.

nextDialogue.title: CLIENT
nextDialogue.plainText: We tolerate it, doesn't make it legal.

SecurityOnShowLowLevelBad.title: CLIENT
SecurityOnShowLowLevelBad.plainText: Why would you show that to me?

ClientArrestDialog.title: CLIENT
ClientArrestDialog.plainText: Hey, what's the meaning of this?

nextDialogue.title: SEC
nextDialogue.plainText: Just cooperate, and this will be over soon.

nextDialogue.title: SEC
nextDialogue.plainText: We have some questions for you. Let's go.

WildNetworkContinue.title: CLIENT
WildNetworkContinue.plainText: Let me explain something to you.

nextDialogue.title: CLIENT
nextDialogue.plainText: This little sector of ours is an ecosystem.

nextDialogue.title: CLIENT
nextDialogue.plainText: Take too much without giving anything back...

nextDialogue.title: CLIENT
nextDialogue.plainText: The balance is broken and everything collapses.

nextDialogue.title: CLIENT
nextDialogue.plainText: I am willing to do you some favors and, in return...

nextDialogue.title: CLIENT
nextDialogue.plainText: You look out for the Lower Levels from time to time.

SecAugDialog.title: SEC
SecAugDialog.plainText: Damn it! The Aug is gone again?!

nextDialogue.title: SEC
nextDialogue.plainText: If you see an Aug again,

nextDialogue.title: SEC
nextDialogue.plainText: You better shoot it on sight!

nextDialogue.title: SEC
nextDialogue.plainText: They hacked into our comms.

nextDialogue.title: SEC
nextDialogue.plainText: Alright, stay safe.

MentorShotgunDialog.title: The Mentor
MentorShotgunDialog.plainText: Hey, have you seen the news?

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor
nextDialogue.plainText: Something's wrong with the new brain implants they just released.

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor
nextDialogue.plainText: Apparently the AI inside those implant went rogue and were able to take over their host.

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor
nextDialogue.plainText: Those taken over by the implants are being referred as Augs.

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor
nextDialogue.plainText: They are pretending to be normal while kidnapping and augmenting more people.

nextDialogue.title: The Mentor
nextDialogue.plainText: Here, I got this for you. Don't worry, I already handled the paperworks.
